# Brute Medications
Brute damage is blunt, slash and piercing: punches, claws, blades and bullets. Dress the wounds first so they stop bleeding (see [textlink="Wounds and Bleeding" link="CMUGuideMedicalWounds"]), then use these to heal the damage.
- [bold]Bicaridine[/bold]: the standard brute medicine. Overdose at 30 units. - [bold]Meralyne[/bold]: heals brute faster than bicaridine, for severe trauma. Its overdose is lower, at 15 units, and corrodes cells. - [bold]Tricordrazine[/bold]: heals a little of everything, brute included.
